dex.entry: A scrappy little terrace-sparrow that pecks spark-producing pyrite from the cliff walls and stores the flint-chips under its wing to use as a crude battery during battle. A sparrow that carries flint to start fires — more resourceful than it looks.

art.silhouette: Compact passerine bird, rust-brown and dark slate-blue plumage, a puffed chest crossed by a small leather-look pouch of flint pebbles, tiny defiant eyes; cheeky and small at 32px.
